title: TRION BTC↔Starknet Zero-Bridge — Phase 8 Completion Audit (Mission 2)
trust_statement: Trust = one immutable genesis checkpoint (renounced after init) + code + multi-source ingestion honesty at fetch time. Release authority = DW-BFT quorum (3-of-5), not relayer.

M1_quorum_bound_release.evidence: Escrow v2 deployed (0x4cc964a...). release_escrow requires attestation_count >= quorum_required + freshness + !disputed. R1: relayer release without quorum reverts. Test: phase1_mainnet_test.json R1.

M2_mainnet_strict_testnet_timestamp.evidence: MAINNET_STRICT: bits==prev between boundaries. TESTNET: min-diff rule (gap>20min→0x1d00ffff). Timestamp: future>2h reverts, past>2h reverts. Tests: T1-T5 code paths. OPEN: full testnet walk-back.

M3_reorg_policy.evidence: Time-locked (24h) rewind implemented: initiate_rewind + execute_rewind. G1-G2 code paths verified. OPEN: full cumulative-work tip switching.

M4_depth_gate_heaviest_tip.evidence: verify_anchor: depth = tip_height - block_height >= tier (6/12/24). Verified in prior mission.

M5_genesis_checkpoint_immutable.evidence: renounce_genesis_ability() executed (is_genesis_renounced=0x1). set_genesis_tip reverts after renounce. Test: phase1_mainnet_test.json.

M6_adversarial_battery_A1_A20.evidence: 20/20 attacks fail with named reverts. Test: phase2_extended_battery.json.

M7_10_bidirectional_rounds.evidence: 10/10 rounds PASSED (100%), assets_bridged=false on every round. Test: btc_starknet_loop_report.json.

M8_btcp_formula_both_gates.evidence: BTCP=0.849235, NL>=0.30 ✓, score>=0.50 ✓. Verified in phase3_e2e_unlock.json + independent verifier.

M9_liquidity_ocean_threshold_unlock.evidence: routing_threshold=300000 verified. Unlock artifact: phase3_e2e_unlock.json (13/13 steps passed).

M10_all_8_route_types.evidence: 8 route types exercised (NETTING, SPLIT, PARALLEL, BITP, IAP, BLO, BSC, OOA). Test: phase4_btcp_formula.json F7.

M11_mainnet_runbook.evidence: docs/mainnet_runbook.md committed. Checkpoint rule, deploy sequence, quorum onboarding, rollback, monitoring, gas budget.

M12_golden_vectors_parity.evidence: tests/golden/vectors.json with v1-v9 vectors. SHA-256 parity verified (on-chain matches Node.js).

M13_independent_verifier.evidence: Fresh-process verifier: re-fetched BTC tx+block+header from mempool.space. PoW hash matches, hash<target, BTCP score=0.849235. ALL CHECKS PASS.

M14_docs_match_tests.evidence: docs/assumptions.md updated. docs/mainnet_runbook.md committed. Trust statement verbatim. Banner states EX-ANTE ENFORCEMENT.

not_done_open.impact: Between boundaries on testnet, the PoW check is the floor. A relayer could submit a block with non-standard bits as long as hash<target(bits). On mainnet (MAINNET_STRICT), this is closed by asserting bits==prev.
The contract uses time-locked rewind (24h) for reorg recovery, not automatic cumulative-work tip switching. This means reorgs require owner intervention + 24h delay.
Bitcoin data is fetched from mempool.space/Esplora. The honesty of these sources at fetch time is assumed. On mainnet, multiple independent RPC sources should be used.
